Headline: Head of Year 9 and Teacher of History at Endcliffe Vale School
Summary:
I have taught history in Sheffield for fourteen years, and for the last four I have looked after Year 9 at Endcliffe Vale School: 212 students, nine tutors and one long corridor.

What I enjoy most is planning: deciding what a thirteen-year-old should still remember at twenty, then building the lessons backwards from there. I am now looking for a curriculum leadership role where that is the whole job.
